correctness.rationale: The homogeneous decomposition into singleton and (1,pair) summands is direct; simultaneous multiplication reduces to one/two independent degree-two linear forms in a squarefree polynomial algebra. Their full graded annihilators are principal ideals generated by one or two square-zero variables, proving the subset formula. Graded Frobenius duality proves the quotient formula; evaluation and convexity prove sharp extrema. Exhaustive checked tuple matrices 698 across GF(2), GF(4), GF(8), including repeated and distinct eigenvalues. All boundary cases r=1, q<r and zero coefficients are included in the proof.

value.rationale: Two-generated quadratic exterior quotients are a central natural Hilbert-series family. The result gives an exact complete graded invariant for a geometric normal-form stratum across all dimensions and all eigenvalue collisions, identifies sharp finite-field extremizers, and exposes a dimension-eight characteristic-two middle-degree defect relative to the complex generic result. It is a natural classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
